title.narrative: Palestine Strategy Group (PSG) 2022-2023 - Identifying Areas Of Palestinian Strategic Engagements in the US

description.narrative:
The Project's expected effect(s) on society (Impact) is increased readiness and capacity for Palestinian input into principled negotiations and conflict resolution. The Israel-Palestine conflict thus becomes less intractable.
The expected effects for the target group of the Project (Outcome) are: 1. The role of the US as a third-party peacemaker is strategized so that it feeds into policy formulation by Palestinian political and civil leadership and public engagements. 2. Increased alliances between key policy constituencies in the US (including Palestinian RAD) and the Palestinian homeland. 3. Palestinian and US institutions and civil society incorporate Collective Strategic Thinking into their approach to the conflict, giving more traction to future conflict resolution.
The planned main products and/or services of the Project (Outputs) are: 1. Research on three arenas of strategic engagement. 2. Collective strategic thinking on three draft reports focusing on arenas of strategic engagement. 3. Collective Strategic Thinking is shared with external stakeholders. 4. Quality control on collective strategic thinking is assured. 5. Collective Strategic Thinking is formulated. 6. Key policy points from Collective Strategic Thinking are advocated for by Palestinians to US constituencies. 7. PLO Research Centre internalizes the value of collective strategic thinking into their approach. 8. CSO are familiarized with strategic briefing.
The intended target group is Palestinian and American constituencies/populations
